hypotheses: Admission enquiries across 7 branches are tracked by counsellors by phone and visit with no shared enquiry-to-admission-to-fee pipeline. This is inferred only from the absence of any online booking or portal on the admissions page.
Fee collection and instalment reminders are manual (registers or Excel) or sit in whatever software sends the SMS alerts. Nothing observed either way.
The SMS alerts probably run on some attendance or bulk-SMS tool. If that is the same local vendor as the school app (Microweb), the group already has an ERP vendor and resistance is higher.
A 2022 white-label app with about 10 installs for the Sola branch suggests an earlier trial that was not adopted network-wide. This is inferred and the ownership link is unconfirmed.
The unfinished template website and 911 Instagram followers suggest low digital investment or attention, so the owner may be reachable but not tech-driven. Weak inference.
The coaching institute and GYANJYOT PUBLIC SCHOOL likely share promoters (same brand and same compound), but this is not confirmed on any page.
dossier.ability_to_pay: Structural, not financial. Seven branches in commercial premises (a retail-mall floor above Croma, Thaltej and Prahladnagar arcades), three branches independently seen operating on Google Maps with 4.2 to 4.7 ratings, a sister school paying a vendor for a parent app, and 90% scholarships (suggesting margin). Staff and classroom numbers are self-reported. No ad activity, funding or fee data was checked.
dossier.resistance: Moderate. (1) A parent-communication system already exists: weekly test-result SMS and daily absentee alerts. (2) The same brand's school arm uses a Microweb Solutions parent app that covers attendance, homework and fee dues, and a 2022 Octopod/Studentink app exists for the Sola branch, so the owner knows school-ERP vendors. (3) No decision-maker contact is published beyond a generic Gmail and branch counsellor lines. (4) No anti-AI or anti-bot positioning seen. The web vendor is an agency, not an ERP, and holds no ERP lock-in.
dossier.best_angle: Do not pitch 'you have no parent updates', since SMS alerts already exist. Lead with multi-branch admission enquiry and follow-up: counsellors take enquiries by phone and visit across 7 branches, so offer one shared WhatsApp-first pipeline from enquiry to appointment to admission to fee follow-up. Open with a question about how the branches keep enquiries and fee dues consolidated today and which system sends their SMS, which also tests the resistance hypothesis.
dossier.best_channel: Email to the published business address (gyanjyot079@gmail.com), addressed to the Director, followed by a human phone call to the Bopal House line asking for management. No WhatsApp opt-in route exists (no wa.me link or WhatsApp-labelled number), so cold WhatsApp is not recommended.
dossier.case_for: Real, owner-led, 27+ year institute with 7 listed branches. Three branches are independently confirmed on Google Maps, and the founder-Director is named on the About page. Admission is entirely by call or visit to a branch, with no online booking, payment or portal. Batch-heavy (60+ batches of 15) and multi-location, which is the structural fit for one system across branches. Seven separate branch phone numbers suggest fragmented intake. Not a franchise or a reseller, and the web vendor is not an ERP.
dossier.case_against: The need is inferred, not observed: no page shows registers, Excel or WhatsApp-group handling or lost fees. Counter-evidence exists: parents already get test-result and absentee SMS, the group's school arm has a vendor-built parent app with fee-due alerts (updated Nov 2024), and a Sola branch app existed in 2022. The owner has no direct contact route, only a generic Gmail and branch phones. Most size claims (100+ teachers, 42 classrooms) come from the institute's own half-finished template site, which has 0 counters and conflicting years. Social presence is small (911 followers). This is a low B and would drop to C if a branch confirms the existing vendor already covers admissions and fees.

challenge.strongest_objection: The need is not observed anywhere, and the only direct evidence about how they run parent communication points the other way. They already send weekly test-result SMS and daily absentee SMS, which means attendance is captured digitally, and a sister school at the same address and the Sola app show a family of ed-tech purchases. Nothing public shows registers, Excel or lost fees. Under the grade rule, B needs either an observed need or strong pay and strong reach with an inferred need. Pay is only moderate (self-reported size on a template site) and reach is a generic Gmail plus branch phones with no direct route to the named Director. That makes this a real, well-fitting prospect with thin evidence, not a B.
corrections: Grade C, not B. Need is inferred, pay is moderate and reach is weak, so neither B condition is met.

What would earn B: (1) a published owner or Director contact, or a company or registry record showing who runs it. (2) Observed need, such as a review or ad that complains about fee follow-up, admission handling or slow replies, or one human call to a branch confirming enquiries and fees are tracked by hand. (3) Evidence of ad activity in the admission season (Meta Ad Library was not checked). (4) Finding out which system sends the SMS alerts. If it turns out to be a full coaching ERP, drop to reject for 'already has a solution'.

Remove the finder's 'four Maps pins with 101, 40, 21 and 65 reviews' and 'TargetStudy shows 6 rows'. Verified: House 101, South Bopal 40, TRP 23 (investigator), plus my own re-check of House at 4.7 and 101.
Move 'the group buys a local school-ERP parent app' from observed facts to hypothesis. The Public School, the Sola app and the coaching institute may be different entities.

Add observed facts: Google Business posts dated 2026-05-23 promote 100% CBSE 10th results and a prize Activa for toppers. About 30 newest reviews of the House pin contain no complaint about fees, admissions or parent updates.

Pay signal: moderate, not strong. Reach: weak to moderate, not business_contact. Best first touch remains the investigator's: do not claim 'no parent updates' since SMS alerts exist. Ask how seven branches consolidate enquiries and fee dues, and which system sends the SMS. Use email to gyanjyot079@gmail.com addressed to the Director, then a human call to the Bopal House line, and no cold WhatsApp.

The Thaltej, Prahladnagar, Sola and Swastik Greens branches are single-source (the institute's own contact page). Apify spend for my check is about US$0.02.
